question: The National Conference on “Strengthening Legal Aid Delivery Mechanisms” in November 2025 was inaugurated at ____.

options.text: Supreme Court of India, New Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Supreme Court of India, New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Conference on **“Strengthening Legal Aid Delivery Mechanisms”** was inaugurated in **November 2025** at the **Supreme Court of India, New Delhi**.
 
• The conference was organized to bring together stakeholders from the judiciary and legal fraternities to enhance the reach and efficiency of **legal aid services** across the country.
 
• The venue, the **Supreme Court of India**, serves as the apex judicial body, and hosting such a conference there signifies the high priority the Indian judiciary places on **access to justice** for all.
 
• Key discussions during the event focused on the implementation of **Article 39A** of the **Constitution of India**, which mandates the state to provide **free legal aid** to the poor and weaker sections of society.
